levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Explanations of what each document proves are interchangeable or confused between types.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Correctly explains what at least two of the three documents prove.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Correctly and distinctly explains what all three documents prove and how long each stays useful.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Named details are generic ('the date') without explaining why they matter for that document.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names specific details and gives a plausible reason for at least two documents.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Names specific details for all three documents with a clear reason tied to what could go wrong.

criteria.dimension: Reasoning about why documents get lost

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Reflection is a single-word or dismissive answer ('people are lazy').

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Offers a plausible reason that connects to the specific delay between getting the document and needing it.

lookFors: The three explanations of what each document proves are genuinely distinct from one another.
The details named as most important would plausibly be the details actually needed to resolve a real problem.
The reflection avoids blaming or shaming language about people who lose documents.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
